knowledge.content:
# The 24/7 Software Engineer
for your Codebase

Automated code reviews that catch bugs, enforce standards, and help you ship faster. Set up in under 2 minutes.

Sign Up for Free | Read the Docs

Zero Data Retention
No Config Required

## How It Works

Get started in under 2 minutes. No configuration files required.

1.  ### Connect Your Repo

    Sign in with GitHub and select the repositories you want Codii to monitor.

2.  ### Open a Pull Request

    Codii automatically detects new PRs and scans them. You can also trigger a review manually by commenting `codii review`.

3.  ### Review & Merge

    Get AI-powered comments on bugs and style issues directly in your PR timeline.

## More Than Just a Code Reviewer

Codii gives you a complete dashboard to manage your PRs, track code quality, and customize your review standards.

*   **Centralized Dashboard**
    View all your open PRs across multiple repositories in one place. Track review status, merge times, and recent activity at a glance.
*   **Productivity Metrics**
    Gain insights into your team's velocity with metrics like Average Merge Time, PR Size, and Daily Activity stats.
*   **Custom Review Rules**
    Define custom instructions (e.g., "Always use TDD" or "Prefer functional patterns") that Codii will enforce during reviews.
*   **Repository Control**
    Easily toggle reviews on/off for specific repositories. Configure scan frequency (per PR or per commit) to suit your workflow.
*   **Smart Summaries**
    Get high-level summaries of changes in every PR, helping reviewers understand context before diving into the code.
*   **Flexible Scheduling**
    Choose when to run reviews: automatically on every commit, only when a PR is opened, or trigger them manually.

## Get more out of your code reviews.

See how Codii catches issues that manual reviews often miss.

`src/components/UserProfile.tsx`

`f @foobarbaz`
`codii review`

codiibot
Analysed 40 lines in 3 files in 22 seconds.

*   ### Instant

    Get immediate feedback on your code changes.
    Codii assists your team by providing instant preliminary reviews.

*   ### Configurable

    Codii generates comprehensive PR summaries and inline comments.
    Make your reviews understand your style, preferences and goals.

*   ### Code Quality Analytics

    Track code quality metrics and improvement trends.
    Help your team identify areas for growth and development.

## Powered By The Models You Trust

Supported models include: OpenAI, Claude, Google Gemini

## Built for Developers, by Developers

*   🔒 ### Secure & Private

    Your code stays private. We don't store or share your source code.

*   ⚡ ### Fast Setup

    Get started in under 2 minutes! No complex configuration.

*   🤖 ### Multi-Model

    Choose from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google. Adding more models each week!

## Choose Your Plan
